svg.title: BSWorld architecture with mixed Zephyr and Python Controllers
svg.desc: Native and QEMU Hosts connect to Zephyr Controller processes or Python BSController instances through dedicated H4 Unix sockets. Bumble Hosts, Python Controller worker threads and the framework clock belong to the BSWorld pytest process. Each H4 server runs in its Controller worker thread. Each Controller radio and clock participant has a separate FIFO endpoint to the shared BabbleSim PHY. Zephyr and Python Controllers write HCI snoop directly to per-instance files using local simulation timestamps. BSWorld converts PHY transmission CSV files to Ellisys at teardown.
svg.text: Mixed Controller implementations on one shared PHY and simulation timeline
BLE modem · channel attenuation · shared simulation time
RF capture from all Controller implementations
Dashed purple: Host / framework clock FIFOs
BSWorld: PHY Tx CSV → Python conversion
One dedicated HCI socket per Host / Controller pair.
Host runtime and Controller implementation are independent.
Each Controller instance owns its radio endpoint; capture files do not relay HCI traffic.
